{{Quote|Responsible citizens are encouraged to join in this effort and send a message that the disreputable shipping practices of offworld freighters are not welcome here.|The Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce|<ref name="SWG:OSCMA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Open Shipping Consortium Menace Again}} on Corellia</ref>}}
The '''Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce''', abbreviated '''CDSICoC''', was an organization charged with representing and protecting the commercial interests of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rather conservative, the Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce competed with the progressive [[Open Shipping Consortium]] (OSC). The CDSICoC was firmly opposed to the opening of Corellian shipping lanes to offworlders while the OSC was favorable to this measure. The Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce argued that such 
reform would lead to shoddy work and a general lack of professionalism. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the rivalry between the two organizations escalated into conflict.<ref name="SWG:OSCMA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> when a freighter dumped several cargoes of dangerous animals into populated areas of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], each organization blamed pilots affiliated with its concurrent to be responsible for the situation. Then, both the CDSICoC and the OSC recruited [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to hunt the creatures.<ref name="SWG:OSCMA" /><ref name="SWG:PTFC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Powermongers Throttle Free Commerce}} on Corellia</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:OSCMA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce was mentioned in two missions called "Open Shipping Consortium Menace Again" and "Powermongers Throttle Free Commerce" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:OSCMA" /><ref name="SWG:PTFC" />
